protection: Exact Decimal value/sign/precision at numeric stage; no scale conversions; no formula or compound-unit rewriting; unchanged evidence/metadata; modal and negation preservation; exact edit provenance.

cache: Exact doc/question/context hash only for QA; exact before/after pair hash only for meaning review.

review_pairing_correction.scope: Review metadata only; no summary/QA/audit changes, no new GPU calls.
